newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM-KYMMENE HITS NEW LOW AS SECTOR DIVES.
newsitem.headline: UPM-KYMMENE HITS NEW LOW AS SECTOR DIVES.

text.p: Shares in Europe's biggest forestry group UPM-Kymmene Oy hit a new life-low in moderate trade on Thursday as forestries remained depressed following recent pessimistic analyst comments, brokers said.
At 1230/1030, UPM traded at 86.50 markka, down 1.30 markka or 1.5 percent, after hitting a new 85.50 markka all-time low. Trade was a moderate ten million markka.
Brokers said overseas investors were particularly active sellers. The forestry sub-index lost 1.28 percent as forestries slipped across the board. U.S. paper stocks also fell overnight.
